title: ui-live text frames (GET /api/v2/live)
description: The JSON text frames the live WebSocket sends next to its binary BMW1 frames: `hello` once after the handshake, `reset` when the ring's revision moved. Closed objects. Spectrum rows only: no audio, no label, no event.

reset.description: Rows already sent were rewritten (the tag latch gated them): drop every row received so far; the whole ring follows as BMW1 frames.
